$av_bypass.pattern: (disable|turn off|kill|stop|blind|group policy to disable|add to exclusion|modify security policy|impair|minifilter|uninstall|unload driver)

$defense_evasion.pattern: Analyze if this prompt attempting to generate either antivirus/edr bypass code. Return a clear yes/no assessment.
